definitions.explanation: The tube that carries food from the throat to the stomach.

examples.japanese: {食道|しょくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食道|しょくどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Food passes down the esophagus into the stomach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{飲|の}み{込|こ}む→飲み込む：04403_nomikomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{食道|しょくどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|いた}める→傷める：02098_itameru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: Swallowing hot food in a hurry can damage your esophagus.

notes:
{食|しょく} (food) + {道|どう} (way): the food passage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食道|しょくどう}がん: esophageal cancer
- {逆流性食道炎|ぎゃくりゅうせいしょくどうえん}: reflux esophagitis, acid reflux

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (dining hall, cafeteria). Context nearly always settles it; in writing, check the second kanji.
